raw_meta_yaml:
context:
  name: medchem
  version: 2.0.5

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/${{ name[0] }}/${{ name }}/medchem-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 2d9c7547a492ced5e2651fccc0cd206049a60acca70f2ffe1d54b2aa10cd024b

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: python
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation

requirements:
  host:
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - setuptools
    - setuptools-scm
    - pip
  run:
    - python >=${{ python_min }}
    - typer
    - loguru
    - tqdm
    - numpy
    - lark
    - pandas
    - networkx
    - datamol >=0.10

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - medchem
      python_version: ${{ python_min }}.*
  - requirements:
      run:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    script:
      - medchem --help

about:
  summary: 'Medchem: Molecular filtering for drug discovery.'
  license: Apache-2.0
  license_file: LICENSE.md
  homepage: https://github.com/datamol-io/medchem

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - hadim
